Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 69 - November 2023

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components. 

Mobility Service –

  1. Added support for Linux OS for:
    • Azure to Azure – Rocky Linux 8.7, Rocky Linux 9.0, Rocky Linux 9.1, and SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP5
    • Modernized VMware/Physical to Azure - Rocky Linux 8.7, Rocky Linux 9.0, Rocky Linux 9.1, and SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 SP5 
       
  2. Added support for Windows OS for:
    • Azure to Azure – Windows 11

This update also provides bug fixes. Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
